warnings.message: npm: no exact version is pinned, so depcurfew configures for npm 12.2.1, the latest version it knows
warnings.fix: Pin the version you use (packageManager, devEngines, .tool-versions or a CI setup step) to configure for it

warnings.message: npm is not pinned for the repository, and npm 11.16.0 to 11.20.0 (which Node.js >=22 in devEngines (package.json) can come with) runs dependency install scripts that allowScripts does not cover unless strict-allow-scripts is set, so depcurfew apply writes strict-allow-scripts=true; with it, in npm 12.0.0 and later the install fails instead of blocking the script with a warning
warnings.fix: Pin one npm version (packageManager or devEngines) to configure for it alone; with strict-allow-scripts, review the packages an install stops at and add them to installScripts.allow or installScripts.deny in depcurfew.json

warnings.message: npm 10.5.1 to 11.13.0 (which Node.js >=22 in devEngines (package.json) can come with) runs every dependency install script and has no allow-list, so "deny" cannot be enforced there
warnings.fix: Install npm 11.16.0 or later before packages are installed there (npm install -g npm@11.16.0), or move to a Node.js release that comes with it; npm 12 blocks dependency scripts by default

warnings.message: npm: allowScripts takes package names only; "@scope/*" not written
warnings.fix: List the package names in installScripts.allow

warnings.message: Renovate: configuration in package.json is deprecated and depcurfew does not edit it
warnings.fix: Move it to renovate.json, or add the snippet by hand
